summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Communications Tab (Campaigns and Templates). All 40 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: Campaign Builder wizard (5 steps), Template Editor with variable insertion, campaigns list with status badges, templates grid view. All CRUD operations working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Campaign send functionality is MOCKED - marks campaigns as sent and creates recipient records but doesn't actually send emails/SMS
All Campaign APIs properly implemented: GET list, GET single, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST duplicate, POST send, POST schedule, POST pause, POST resume
All Template APIs properly implemented: GET list, GET single, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST duplicate, GET variables
Audience segments correctly calculated from event_attendees table: all, vip, not_checked_in, checked_in
Campaign Builder wizard has 5 steps: Basics (name, channel, type), Audience (segment selection), Content (template/custom), Schedule (now/later), Review
Template Editor has variable insertion sidebar with Attendee, Event, and System variable categories
data-testid attributes properly implemented for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: 1 campaign (Welcome Email, status: sent), 2 templates (Registration Confirmation, Test Template from UI). Test data with TEST_ prefix was cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Communications Tab fully functional. All Campaign APIs tested: GET /campaigns (list), GET /campaigns/stats, GET /campaigns/audience-segments, POST /campaigns/preview-audience, POST /campaigns (create), GET /campaigns/:id, PUT /campaigns/:id, DELETE /campaigns/:id, POST /campaigns/:id/duplicate, POST /campaigns/:id/send (MOCKED), POST /campaigns/:id/schedule, POST /campaigns/:id/pause, POST /campaigns/:id/resume. All Template APIs tested: GET /templates (list), GET /templates/variables, POST /templates (create), GET /templates/:id, PUT /templates/:id, DELETE /templates/:id, POST /templates/:id/duplicate. Frontend displays: Campaigns list with columns (Campaign Name, Type, Status, Recipients, Performance, Actions), Templates grid with cards, Campaign Builder wizard (5 steps), Template Editor with variable sidebar.

api_get_campaigns_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/campaigns returns list of campaigns with open_rate and click_rate calculated

api_get_campaign_stats.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/stats returns totalCampaigns, sentCampaigns, scheduledCampaigns, draftCampaigns, totalRecipients, avgOpenRate, avgClickRate

api_get_audience_segments.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/audience-segments returns 4 segments: all, vip, not_checked_in, checked_in with counts

api_create_campaign.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns creates campaign with name, channel (email/sms), campaign_type, template_id, subject, content, audience_rule, scheduled_at

api_update_campaign.details: PUT /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId updates campaign fields, validates status (can only edit draft/scheduled)

api_duplicate_campaign.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/duplicate creates copy with '(Copy)' suffix and draft status

api_send_campaign.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/send (MOCKED) marks campaign as sent, creates recipient records, returns recipientCount

api_schedule_campaign.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/schedule sets scheduled_at and status to 'scheduled'

api_resume_campaign.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/resume changes status from 'paused' back to 'scheduled' or 'draft'

api_preview_audience.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/preview-audience returns count of recipients matching audience_rule

api_get_templates_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/templates returns list of templates with name, channel, subject, content

api_get_template_variables.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/templates/variables returns 3 categories: Attendee, Event, System with variable codes

api_create_template.details: POST /api/events/:eventId/templates creates template with name, channel, subject (email only), content

frontend_campaigns_list.details: Campaigns table displays: Campaign Name, Type (Email/SMS icon), Status (badge), Recipients, Performance (Open%/Click%), Actions dropdown

frontend_templates_grid.details: Templates displayed as cards with channel icon, name, last edited date, and menu (Edit, Duplicate, Delete)

frontend_campaign_builder_wizard.details: 5-step wizard: Basics (name, channel, type), Audience (segment selection with counts), Content (template selector, subject, body with variable badges), Schedule (now/later), Review (summary)

frontend_template_editor.details: Editor with name, channel selection, subject (email), content textarea, and Available Variables sidebar with click-to-insert

frontend_data_testid_attributes.details: All interactive elements have data-testid: campaigns-tab, templates-tab, new-campaign-btn, create-template-btn, campaign-name-input, channel-email, channel-sms, template-name-input, etc.

mocked_functionality.campaign_send: POST /api/events/:eventId/campaigns/:campaignId/send is MOCKED - marks campaign as sent and creates recipient records but doesn't actually send emails/SMS
